parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. Invocation instructions: append DPI engine type restrictions to the DBClusterId parameter description, specifying that the SQL throttling feature is supported only for PostgreSQL and Oracle DPI engine clusters, and MySQL clusters do not support this feature. Invocation instructions: append cluster status prerequisites to the DBClusterId parameter description, specifying that the cluster must be in the Running state when you invoke this API, and that you can invoke the DescribeDBClusters API and perform a Field-specific search on the DBClusterStatus field to query the current state
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID。调用说明：在 DBClusterId 参数描述中追加引擎类型限制说明，明确 SQL 限流功能仅支持 PostgreSQL 和 Oracle 引擎集群，MySQL 集群不支持此功能。调用说明：在 DBClusterId 参数描述中追加集群状态前置条件说明，明确调用此 API 时集群必须处于 Running 状态，并说明可通过 DescribeDBClusters 接口的 DBClusterStatus 字段查询当前状态
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The names of the SQL throttling rules to delete. You can specify multiple rule names to delete rules in batches. Separate multiple names with commas (,).
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html operation to view the details of all SQL throttling rules in the specified cluster, including the rule names
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的SQL限流规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量删除，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html接口查看目标集群下所有SQL限流规则规则的详情，包括规则名称
parameters.name: rule_name_list

Message.description_en:
The message returned for the request.
If the request is successful, `Successful` is returned. If the request fails, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回`Successful`，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.

false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求结果。取值：

true：请求成功。

false：请求失败
